== Synopsis ==

Once upon a time, there were four little Rabbits, and their names were Flopsy, Mopsy, Cotton-tail, and Peter. These four siblings possessed very different natures. Three of them—Flopsy, Mopsy, and Cotton-tail—were good little bunnies, obedient and well-mannered in their ways.

Peter, however, was very naughty, and his character marked him as quite unlike his sisters. Where they were good, he was given to mischief and willfulness. The difference between the naughty rabbit and his respectable siblings was plain to see.

When Flopsy, Mopsy, and Cotton-tail went down the lane to gather blackberries, Peter did not accompany them in this sensible task. Instead, the naughty rabbit ran straight away, following his own inclination rather than joining his well-behaved sisters.

As Peter went his own way, he presently sneezed—'Kertyschoo!' This small detail marks a moment in his journey, though the full course of his adventure lies beyond this portion of the tale.
